The report will be scoped to include agents in M365 Copilot and Copilot Chat with usage by both M365 Copilot licensed and unlicensed users. The report will include total active agent users, total active agents, active users segmentation...

events.title: SharePoint: HTML pages
events.titleJa: SharePoint で HTML ページを作成・公開可能に
events.summary: Create HTML with Copilot in SharePoint or upload your own HTML from another source. Once stored in the pages library, you can render HTML as a page in SharePoint, make additional edits, and share with your audience. HTML gives you new ways to present your content beautifully alongside our existing ASPX pages.
events.summaryJa: SharePoint で Copilot を使って HTML ページを作成したり、外部で作成した HTML をアップロードしたりできます。ページ ライブラリに保存後、SharePoint ページとして表示、編集、共有でき、既存の ASPX ページと並べて表現の幅を広げられます。
events.summaryEn: Create HTML with Copilot in SharePoint or upload your own HTML from another source. Once stored in the pages library, you can render HTML as a page in SharePoint, make additional edits, and share with your audience. HTML gives you new ways to present your content beautifully alongside our existing ASPX pages.

events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Add Agents and Skills from the Plus menu
events.titleJa: Copilot のプラス メニューからエージェントとスキルを追加可能に
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Add Agents and Skills from the Plus menu
events.summary: Users will be able to insert Agents and Skills in prompts for specialized tasks. They can add them from the Agents and Skills tab after selecting 'Add work content' from the plus (+) menu. Users can also access Agents and Skills by typing / and @ in their prompt.
events.summaryJa: Copilot のプラス (+) メニューから [作業内容の追加] を選び、[エージェントとスキル] タブで専用タスク向けのエージェントやスキルをプロンプトに追加できます。/ や @ の入力でも呼び出せます。
events.summaryEn: Users will be able to insert Agents and Skills in prompts for specialized tasks. They can add them from the Agents and Skills tab after selecting 'Add work content' from the plus (+) menu. Users can also access Agents and Skills by typing / and @ in their prompt.
